US Election Officials Fear Federal Interference Amidst Election Denial

US election officials are concerned about potential interference from the federal government, particularly in the context of widespread election denial. Concerns are amplified by the actions and rhetoric of individuals and groups who question the integrity of election processes. The Washington Post reports that election officials fear a new threat from the federal government itself, while The Japan Times highlights the problem posed by an 'army of election deniers'. These reports suggest a climate of distrust and potential challenges to democratic processes.
